title: 阪神JFの後に・しばしの

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fans
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeek! You did great, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text: Heh… Yukino Bijin was pretty good out there.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text: I thought she was just a pretty face, but hey, maybe she'll actually hold her own in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Person with Camera
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin, huh? She sure is cute, but…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I did it… I finished the race…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Person with Camera
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa!

text_block_list.name: Person with Camera
text_block_list.text: Now that's a smile! I need to get a picture!

text_block_list.name: Person with Camera
text_block_list.text: Click!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Good job, Yuki!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu… Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: You're someth'n else, Yuki! I remember you saying what a big deal it is to win a Triple Tiara race…

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: But now I'm abso-positively certain you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Thanks oodles!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: However… there's something I've gotta tell you first.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: We might not be able t'see each other for a while.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I've gotta buckle down and throw myself into my own training too.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna let you leave me behind!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're right. We've both gotta work our heinies off.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That way, next time I meetcha, we can both hold our heads up high!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Right. But don't stop messag'n me on LANE, okay?
choice_data_list: If you're ready, we'll walk you out, Mifuyu.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Just lemme go get changed!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: You know, I always looked up to Yuki. I still do…

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: But you should've see her on the ice. You'd think she had wings, the way she jumped… I was always so jealous of her, haha.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: She's always been the cat's meow. She's my hero.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I was able t'watch her race today. Thank you so much for the invite!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Mifuyu's already split!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, at least I got t'talk to her a bit. She's been cheer'n me up as long as I can remember.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sigh… It kinda breaks my heart know'n we won't be able t'see each other for a while.
choice_data_list: We'll just have to keep pushing forward.
We'll just have to keep pushing forward.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Right you are!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: My classic year's com'n up, which means I'll be tak'n on the Triple Tiara soon!
choice_data_list: First up is the Oka Sho!
First up is the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll be watch'n, Mifuyu!
